title: 2025 vs 2026 AI Tools
transcript: For research, it used to be ChatGPT, now it's Gemini. For building apps, it used to be Replika, now it's Claude code every day. For building websites, it used to be Level Up, now it's Google anti-gravity. For learning new skills, it used to be Coursera, now it's Notebook LM. Personal assistant used to be a real human, now it's Open Clock. For image generation, last year it used to be Midjourney, now it's Nano Banana or Grok. And for typing, I used to use my keyboard, now I just use Whisper Flow. And for brainstorming, last year was ChatGPT, this year it's the only one I still use, but the voice mode. Other than that, ChatGPT ain't very good at that.
